triage.summary: Review article (Sun Z, Reviews in Cardiovascular Medicine) on a deep learning model improving CCTA diagnostic performance in heavily calcified plaques.
triage.why_it_matters: Calcium blooming is the main failure mode of CCTA stenosis reads; any deep-learning fix changes the competitive baseline for automated analysis.
